title: The World’s First Successful Regenerative Furnace
version: British Glass online abstract of Glass Technology 54(3), 93–99
lineage: The original journal article was not obtained. Its online abstract describes a commercially successful furnace built in 1860, but does not explicitly date its first operating run; the selected 1861 Chance event is not asserted to be the world’s first.

passages.note: Abstract: Rotherham glass furnace built in 1860 and earlier unsuccessful work
